questions.question: How many days do I have for standard returns?
questions.answer:
Standard returns are accepted within 30 days of delivery. [returns.md · p. 1]

Personalised products cannot be returned unless they are defective. [returns.md · p. 1]

questions.question: When is a refund issued after inspection?
questions.answer:
Refunds are issued to the original payment method within 7 business days after the returned item passes inspection. [returns.md · p. 2]

A bank may take additional time to display the refund. [returns.md · p. 2]

questions.question: How long does standard delivery take?
questions.answer:
Standard delivery takes 3 to 5 business days after dispatch. [shipping.md · p. 1]

Delivery estimates exclude public holidays. [shipping.md · p. 1]

questions.question: How soon should I report a damaged delivery?
questions.answer:
Report a damaged delivery within 48 hours of receipt. [shipping.md · p. 2]

questions.question: What temperature should I machine wash cotton garments at?
questions.answer:
Machine wash cotton garments at 30 degrees Celsius with similar colours. [product_guide.md · p. 1]

Do not bleach cotton garments. [product_guide.md · p. 1]

questions.question: What USB adapter should I use to charge the rechargeable lamp?
questions.answer:
Charge the rechargeable lamp using a 5V 2A USB adapter. [product_guide.md · p. 2]

Do not charge the lamp while it is wet. [product_guide.md · p. 2]

questions.question: When should a stock discrepancy be reported?
questions.answer:
Report a stock discrepancy to the shift supervisor before the end of the same shift. [store_operations.md · p. 1]

Do not change stock quantities without approval. [store_operations.md · p. 1]

questions.question: How long are click-and-collect orders held?
questions.answer:
Click-and-collect orders are held for 5 calendar days after the ready-for-collection notification. [store_operations.md · p. 2]
